metrics.measurement_rule: record observed monetary cost once per valid run without imputing missing values
metrics.missing_semantics: unknown or unreported cost is JSON null and is never coerced to zero
metrics.invalid_semantics: invalid runs remain invalid and do not receive a fabricated cost
metrics.precision_rule: preserve provider precision in raw data; round only for display

metrics.measurement_rule: true only when the frozen verifier criteria are satisfied for the run
metrics.missing_semantics: unexecuted or unavailable verification is unknown and never coerced to zero
metrics.invalid_semantics: invalid runs do not receive a fabricated verifier outcome

metrics.source: P0 task start and finish event timestamps
metrics.measurement_rule: elapsed milliseconds between first TASK_STARTED and last TASK_FINISHED
metrics.missing_semantics: missing either time boundary yields JSON null and is never coerced to zero
metrics.invalid_semantics: invalid event chronology invalidates the observation
